root_causes.description: product-catalog, the deepest shared dependency of frontend/checkout/recommendation, shows server-side p99 latency saturated at 10000ms (p50 also 10000ms) with no errors, CPU, or restart anomalies. This pure latency saturation propagates to recommendation (→product-catalog), checkout (→product-catalog), and frontend (→product-catalog/recommendation/checkout), exactly matching the affected service set.

evidence.expected_baseline: p99 ~2-5ms (peer leaf services: payment 4.97ms, currency 4.61ms, ad 9.9ms)

evidence.query_or_id: service_name=product-catalog, min_duration_ms=5000 (search_traces): 20 total, 0 with errors, p95_duration=794580ms; top spans ada9012c00553803 user_get_recommendations 164112ms, 3cd138daad7abfd0 user_browse_product 78399ms
evidence.expected_baseline: product-catalog span durations in low milliseconds under normal load

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.95 cores, p99=2.13 cores (no CPU spike)
evidence.expected_baseline: no anomalous CPU consumption; rules out cpu_stress
absence of error logs confirms a latency-only (not error/abort) fault

evidence.observed_value: only normal Scheduling/Pulling/Created/Started events; no OOMKilled/BackOff/CrashLoop
evidence.expected_baseline: no pod restarts or crash events; rules out pod_crash

root_causes.description: recommendation shows the same saturated p99=10000ms (p50=10000ms). Its only downstream is product-catalog and it shows no independent fault signals (no errors, no restarts), so this is most consistent with latency inherited from product-catalog rather than an intrinsic fault.

checkout also shows saturated p99=10000ms (mean=6180ms) but with error_rate=0 throughout the window, consistent with latency propagation from its slow product-catalog dependency rather than an intrinsic checkout fault.

evidence.expected_baseline: error_rate < 0.01; confirms latency-only fault (no http_abort/error surge)

remediation_steps: Restart/redeploy the product-catalog deployment to clear the induced latency (e.g. kubectl rollout restart deployment/product-catalog -n otel-demo).
Inspect product-catalog's backing datastore/DB latency and connection-pool health, since product-catalog is a leaf service whose server-side latency saturates at 10000ms.
Scale product-catalog replicas and enable request timeouts / circuit breakers on callers (recommendation, checkout, frontend) to bound blast radius while the root cause is fixed.
Verify recovery by re-checking product-catalog p99 (should return to single-digit ms) and confirming recommendation/checkout/frontend p99 normalize.
Add/confirm an alert on product-catalog server-side p99 latency to catch saturation earlier.
